_comment: DESK IMAGE for board-p15 (dec-p15-reset-subset, dec-p15-i2c-pulldowns). Not written to any part and not read back: status NOT RUN. The field positions come from a third-party library and are checked only against the Rev 7 defaults listed under cross_check. Write it with the procedure in doc/src/content/docs/architecture/board-p15-programming.md and accept it only on a power-cycle readback equal to these 40 bytes.
status: NOT RUN (never written or read back)

intent.SNK_PDO_NUMB: 2 (PDO1 5 V + PDO2 15 V; 20 V never requested)
